hero.tagline: I design and build web applications and APIs with .NET, Angular and React for clients in the financial, retail and entertainment sectors.

about.title: A bit of my story
about.paragraph1: Senior .NET Developer with 8 years of experience designing and building web applications and APIs with C#, .NET (Framework, Core, .NET 6/8/9) and ASP.NET MVC, complemented by Angular/React and TypeScript on the frontend, for clients in the financial, retail and entertainment sectors. 4 years of experience with Oracle databases, plus SQL Server, and 6 years working in agile teams (Scrum/Kanban).
about.paragraph2: Experience with Clean Architecture, CQRS and design patterns, REST/SOAP API integration, Entity Framework, continuous delivery with Azure DevOps and cloud services on Azure and AWS. I follow Clean Code and SOLID practices and use AI tools (Claude, Cursor) to speed up development and code refactoring.
about.paragraph3: I keep growing: finishing my Systems Engineering degree at UPC, and using Claude and Cursor as part of my daily workflow to speed up development without sacrificing quality.

experience.title: Professional experience
experience.description: A summary of the roles and companies I've worked with.

achievements: Built from scratch, in .NET 8/9 and Angular 21, the Finance, SKU pricing and Logistics/Finance operations systems for Oechsle and Promart Homecenter.

Optimized the batch process that reconciled nationwide sales for Finance (about 1 million records), which ran overnight and took 2 to 4 hours: I redesigned it in .NET with asynchronous parallel batch processing (async/await, Task.WhenAll and SemaphoreSlim) and in-memory preloading of the codes to match, removing record-by-record queries; it now finishes in 6 to 10 minutes and runs during the day.

Finance opened 3 to 4 tickets a day (up to 14 at month-end close) for wrong codes, costs and calculations, with no way to see where the error came from; I restructured the frontend with validations and per-record error tracing, and those tickets dropped drastically.
Built REST services in .NET with JWT, communicating through Kafka and deployed on Docker/Kubernetes, integrated with Azure Functions and Blob Storage, and tested with xUnit/NUnit and Moq.
Maintained and refactored Grupo Gloria's Finance system in .NET 6 and .NET Framework (Clean Architecture, CQRS) and its Oracle PL/SQL packages.

Integrated BCP, Interbank and Scotiabank into Grupo Gloria's Host to Host system, which processes bulk payments for payroll, suppliers and group transfers: payment batches are generated in SAP and sent to each bank through SOAP services.

Migrated the payments platform from Windows Forms to a web application in React and .NET, with bulk payment selection and permission management; Finance went from about 30 minutes to a few minutes per payment run.

Built REST APIs in Java 11 with Spring Boot, combining functional (Streams, Optional) and imperative programming, for the modules of the Gloria product packaging monitoring system, deployed on AWS EKS.
Brought production-line packaging into a real-time dashboard by consuming APIs integrated with the plant PLCs, with log monitoring in ELK (Kibana).
Worked on the "Gloriosa" promotion, broadcast nationwide, with AWS Lambda functions and Python automation scripts.
Designed and built REST APIs in .NET Core for Juntoz.com's Accounting department, including a functional view for calculating daily e-commerce income and expenses.
Developed and maintained frontend interfaces in React with TypeScript, consuming the REST APIs for the system's accounting modules.
Implemented the CQRS pattern through commands, queries and Mediator, achieving a clear separation of responsibilities.
Applied design patterns across the MerchantCentral system's services to improve maintainability and extensibility.
Configured CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps to automate testing, deployments and version management, working under Scrum methodology.
Implemented OAuth 2.0 authentication to secure the API endpoints consumed by the accounting modules.
Built REST APIs in .NET (Core, .NET 5 and .NET 6) for the online casino's internal systems.
Designed and implemented a new API Gateway model with Kong Enterprise, enabling a microservices ecosystem for the online casino.

Created the "Finanzas Atlantic" application to track the online casino's income and expenses, integrating ETL processes from SAP, SQL Server and Oracle, reducing calculation time and data load to the client's ERP systems.
Built serverless functions (AWS Lambda) to automate backend tasks such as event processing and financial report generation, reducing the load on main servers.
Configured monitoring and alerts with Amazon CloudWatch to track platform logs and metrics, improving early detection of production incidents.
Coordinated a 4-person team under Scrum methodology.
Built the CVT application for the ARPAY tribe at BCP, a web application in ASP.NET MVC, with a Bitbucket repository and CI/CD pipeline integration in Jenkins.
Integrated the CVT application with Oracle databases for managing the ARPAY tribe's financial information.
Provided technical documentation for completed developments and real-time support to the ARPAY tribe's teams, under agile Scrum methodology.
Maintenance of Angular 11 and .NET Core/Entity Framework applications for Ferreyros business processes, with continuous delivery on Azure DevOps.
Led and built the Calidda GNV and Data Update apps; mobile apps in Kotlin/Swift.
Built new modules (credit evaluation, card issuance, loan approval) and SOAP/REST services for Compartamos Financiera.
Development and support with ASP.NET Web Forms, Xamarin and Telerik components for BBVA, Entel and Pacífico.

projects.description: A selection of personal and professional projects.

fund-transfer-engine.description: A 2-microservice Java ecosystem that orchestrates fund transfers using the Saga pattern (orchestrated choreography), with automatic compensation on failure.
highlights: Orchestrated Saga pattern with a state machine (PENDING → RESERVED → COMPLETED / CANCELLED_COMPENSATED / FAILED).
Internal communication via gRPC between transaction-orchestrator-service (external gateway) and account-ledger-service (accounting core, closed to the outside).
Automatic compensation (rollback) on simulated confirmation failures, releasing reserved funds.
Combined use of Virtual Threads (Java 21) in the orchestrator and reactive programming (Mutiny) in the ledger, each justified by its contention profile.
Resilience via Circuit Breaker, Retry with backoff/jitter and Bulkhead, configured differently per operation.
Real-time event streaming via Server-Sent Events (SSE).
Distributed tracing across microservices with traceId propagation.
Kubernetes deployment with included manifests (Deployment + Service + health probes).

agile-flow-board.description: A Scrum-based project management system with task administration and real-time Kanban boards.
highlights: Kanban boards with drag & drop using Angular CDK.
Real-time updates via SignalR (task movement, notifications).
Hexagonal Architecture on the backend (Domain, Application, Infrastructure, Api).
JWT authentication with PBKDF2 password hashing (salt + pepper).

grupo-ciencias.description: A full platform for a pre-university academy: institutional landing page, management intranet and a Netflix-style virtual library of educational content.
highlights: Institutional landing page for student acquisition.
Virtual library with a streaming-style interface (video class/content catalog).
React frontend integrated with a .NET backend.
